'''February 1997 St. Louis tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in St. Louis on 23 February 1997. Ryan Mahoney won it undefeated. [[Robert Hallaman|Robert Hallaman Jr.]] ran it and reported it in Decipher's NewsFlash; [[Chris Hunter]], another St. Louis tournament director, assisted.<ref name="nf-stl97">[http://rothko.decipher.com/newsandhighlights/stlouistournament.html And the Last shall be the First: Tourney Report from St. Louis], Decipher NewsFlash (Robert Hallaman Jr., 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19970327231956/http://rothko.decipher.com:80/newsandhighlights/stlouistournament.html Internet Archive]</ref>

* '''Date:''' 23 February 1997
* '''Site:''' St. Louis
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Hoth]] (from the card pool)
* '''Players:''' 32 (3 rounds)
* '''Winner:''' Ryan Mahoney

The players voted to give Decipher's prizes to the last-place finishers rather than the winners. Hallaman, Hunter and All-American Comics donated more prizes, and every player got at least one random rare. Dark Side won 52 games and Light Side 40; 9 games were called on time.<ref name="nf-stl97" />
